user_saw: Two bots in a Telegram group kept replying to each other after exceeding the configured bot-loop budget.
summary: The fix passes Telegram peer-bot identities to the shared loop guard, logs over-budget drops, and cleans up the acknowledgment reaction when a turn is dropped.
reasoning: The July Telegram handler diff preserves a comment describing the earlier platform behavior: bots could receive other bots’ posts in channels, but not in groups. The fix report reproduces the loop with Telegram’s Bot-to-Bot setting enabled, and the dispatch history shows the Telegram adapter already omitted the peer-bot facts the shared guard requires. The evidence points to Telegram’s group delivery capability exposing that omission, with no in-repo trigger identified.
